scope: Only the explicitly requested independent cases are executed; unrequested cases receive no pass or skip records. Available scopes: AFF-27 source menus/accessible legends and Val Verde co-op insertion/command/checkpoint; natural Carrier acquisition/flight through full Game.update; Ravager phase checkpoint reload/rematerialization/recovery/fire. No natural mission victory, exhaustive AI policy, hardware FPS, human comprehension or source-film visual fidelity claim.
assistances: Global RAF gameplay is frozen between actual UI inputs; explicit game.update steps advance insertion, the pilot allocator and the entire Carrier gameplay chain deterministically at1/60.
Carrier and Ravager inspection relocates only the player to navigation-safe positions; no allocated actor/group coordinate, profile, signature, HP, phase, result or clock is assigned.

Carrier acquisition is observed for at most480 full Game.update ticks (8 simulated seconds). A transparent callback observer calls the original and returns its unchanged result; no explicit Bridge launch or target override is used.
Carrier flight captures follow full Game.update, including the production post-update Bridge.sync; all combat managers advance normally during these bounded ticks.
Ravager phase isolation advances the real Simulation/Bridge owners in .25s steps while other gameplay stays paused. Damage uses the actual Horde.applyDamage API with signed player faction.

Ravager saveOperation writes the genuine phase checkpoint; page reload and normal menu resume preserve its finite UID, HP, spent upgrade, signature, strategic time and absolute deadline before owner-driven rematerialization.
Actor closeups use a recorded inspection camera and normal environment visibility refresh. Co-op insertion evidence keeps both genuine game cameras unchanged.
Pilot command/checkpoint controls use real DOM clicks. Pause is observed without strategic time advancement; insertion replay does not spend resources. No save data is patched.
The initial paused AFF-27 HUD receives a normal zero-delta update after insertion; unchanged strategic time, finite UID set and Carrier cargo are asserted before checking its accessible legend.

ui.scope: Source menus, small-map legends, real co-op insertion cameras, finite pilot command and actual checkpoint reload.
assistance: Pause global gameplay between real UI inputs.
Advance actual GameApp.update in 1/60 steps for insertion and three seconds of pilot gameplay.
Render through EngineRenderer.render without changing either game camera.
Read physical canopy traces at the two captured insertion stages; CPU tests separately cover the complete sequence.
Checkpoint replay repeats the normal insertion exit; player position is recorded rather than claimed unchanged. No save, actor, resource, phase or simulation clock is patched.

briefings.summary: LV-742 : les quatre fronts de la ruche des faillesLV-742 — bassin atmosphérique et ruche des failles · 16 secteurs · 4 fronts · positions en unités de jeu.Forces alliées : 24 combattants alloués. Forces adverses : présence signalée ; réserves à confirmer par reconnaissance.Plafond de proximité : 32 combattants. Les forces distantes restent actives ; leur position est connue par rapports, avec incertitude.Commandement adverse : Équilibré. Les effectifs, PV et dégâts restent identiques ; les décisions et prises de risque changent.Front essentiel perdu : 599 s au minimum pour revenir et le reprendre, selon les voies ouvertes.Plafond provisoire : 32 combattants proches ; proposition source : 136. Les unités excédentaires restent simulées à distance. Performances sur matériel non mesurées.Chasseur déployé : JUNGLE HUNTER (1987) · Chasseur déployé pour cette opération.Opération indépendante ; aucune chronologie générale imposée au personnage.Aucun service confirmé · 0 mission(s) confirmée(s) pour ce chasseur · statut narratif inchangé.Variante optionnelle — Carrier et Ravager : 6 parasites déjà alloués au Carrier, capacité 6.Objectifs : Neutraliser la logistique de la ruche → Neutraliser l’appui des Marines → Vaincre la reine des failles → Assurer la route de retour du clan → Extraire le contingent de LV-742Échecs : joueurs vaincus ; front allié perdu durablement.Choisissez votre équipement et une première route.
